clips.title: The story
paras: Samuel's Remains are the recovered earthly remnants of Samuel Fipps, a former resident of Tirisfal Glades who fell to the Scourge. Gathered by adventurers near Deathknell, they are laid to rest beside his wife Marla to fulfill her dying wish.

Before the plague of undeath swept across Lordaeron, Samuel Fipps lived peacefully with his wife, Marla. When the contagion struck, Samuel succumbed and was bound into mindless service to the Scourge. Marla escaped undeath only to be struck down by the very husband she loved. Despite this brutal end, her final wish was not vengeance, but eternity together: she pleaded to be interred beside Samuel once his cursed form was put to rest. Novice Elreth in Deathknell enlists newly awoken Forsaken to track down Samuel's wandering form northeast of the settlement, recover his bones, and bury them in the front row of the local cemetery.
